title: feat(chat): move stickToBottom lib to ui components
body:
**Summary**

- Extracts the `stickToBottom` utility from `react-instantsearch` to `instantsearch-ui-components` for cross-package reuse
- Updates the chat widget in React Instantsearch and Instantsearch.js to use the shared utility
